email.subject: Northwind Plumbing: two quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I checked Northwind Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: it's not mobile-friendly, so anyone searching for a plumber from their phone (most people with a leak) has a hard time using it, and there's no way to book or request service online, so they have to call during business hours or leave.

I fix exactly these kinds of issues for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing what I'd change and why.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
